panel.title: Meta Assistant
panel.description: Your sales and marketing operations assistant, powered by Meta.

configureAi.title: We are preparing Meta Assistant
configureAi.description: We are connecting your assistant’s intelligence. You can chat here when it is ready.

welcome.title: Turn your goal into a marketing proposal
welcome.description: Ale starts with {business}'s SaleADS data to research the market and coordinate your specialist team.
welcome.question: What would you like to achieve for your business? Tell Ale in your own words; it will use what it already knows and only ask for missing information.
welcome.approval: You will review the goal before starting. This work prepares a proposal; it does not publish campaigns or spend your budget.

composer.label: Discuss your goal with Ale
composer.hint: Clarify your goal or answer Ale's questions.
composer.feedbackLabel: What would you like to improve in this proposal?
composer.feedbackHint: Your feedback will be linked to this revision.

firstLoop.selectBusiness: Select a business in SaleADS to prepare its marketing goal.
firstLoop.processing: Your message is in progress. You can close this view and check again later.
firstLoop.feedbackReceived: {count, plural, one {Your feedback was recorded.} other {Your # feedback messages were recorded.}}
firstLoop.workingHint: The team keeps working when you close this view. Come back to recover its progress.

errors.unavailable: We couldn't send this message. Your draft is here so you can try again.
errors.uncertain: We are checking whether your message was received. Your draft stays here until it is confirmed.
errors.stale: The context changed. We're updating the conversation; review your message before sending it again.
errors.turnFailed: Ale couldn't complete this message. You can try again.
errors.turnUnknown: We are checking whether your message completed.

workStatus.running: The team is working on your proposal.
workStatus.awaiting_feedback: The proposal is ready for your feedback.
workStatus.reviewing: The team is reviewing your feedback.
workStatus.blocked: The work needs attention. Review the messages and latest available result.
workStatus.unknown: We cannot confirm the work status yet.

projection.missing: Waiting for the team’s first status update.
projection.stale: The status is not up to date. We kept the last received results.
projection.invalid: We could not verify the latest update. We kept the last received results.
projection.unavailable: We could not receive the latest update. We kept the last received results.

failure.auth: Your assistant’s service is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.quota: Your assistant’s service could not respond right now. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.rate_limit: The service is receiving many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.generic: Your assistant could not respond this time. You can send your message again.
failure.not_ready: Your assistant is still getting ready. Try again when it is ready.
failure.restarting: Your assistant is restarting. Send your message again in a few seconds.

landingFeedback.wrongBusiness: Select this proposal’s business before sending changes.

robotCompanion.linkedCount: {count, plural, one {# companion linked} other {# companions linked}}

dialog.title: Link your companion
dialog.description: Type the code shown on Ale's face. If you scanned the QR code, it's already filled in.

form.label: Robot code
form.hint: It's 8 letters and numbers, like K7QM-3XPA. The code lasts 10 minutes.

success.title: {name} is now your companion!
success.description: It can talk with you and remember your conversations, just like the chat.

robotCompanion.unavailable: Linking a companion isn't available for your account yet.

errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check your robot's face and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait about 10 minutes and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Reload the page and sign in again.
errors.generic: We couldn't link your companion. Please try again in a moment.

revoke.title: Unlink {name}?
revoke.description: The robot will stop talking with your assistant right away. To use it again you'll need to link it with a new code.
revoke.error: We couldn't unlink it. Please try again.
